name: ps-command-index-linear-lookups
body: CommandIndex resolves a command by linear scans: export-set deduplication uses Vec::contains, a name lookup scans candidates by index, and every candidate name is lower-cased per comparison, so an unmatched command such as a builtin walks every module export before falling through. Limit: lookup cost grows with the total export count; it is fine at dbatools scale (about 700 exports). Upgrade to a lower-cased name map (HashMap) when scans of very large module sets become slow.
